control_need.evidence: Control. That's the word. I've always had to have control over everything I do.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I've made mistakes. Of course I have. But I'd rather make mistakes than play it safe.

trust_propensity.evidence: I don't trust anyone who isn't a little bit obsessed with what they do.

risk_appetite.evidence: I'm not going to change one thing in this show. If they want to arrest me, let them arrest me.

self_efficacy.evidence: I'm tough, I'm ambitious, and I know exactly what I want. If that makes me a bitch, okay.

autonomy_need.evidence: I'm going to keep doing what I want with my body, my art, my life. I don't need permission.

intimacy_need.evidence: Having a child changes everything. It softened me, but it didn't make me less driven.

status_sensitivity.evidence: Comparing me to younger artists? I paved the road they're driving on.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: To all the women who've been beaten down, silenced, told they're too much — thank you for not letting anybody stop you.

core_models.name: 重塑即生存
core_models.rule: 静止等于死亡；每个阶段都必须主动重塑自我以避免被时代淘汰。
evidence: I reinvent myself because I get bored. And boredom, to me, is death.
Reinvention is survival. If you stand still, you're finished.

core_models.name: 挑衅作为文化诊断
core_models.rule: 把公众反应视为社会文化的诊断工具，冲击本身即是有价值的表达。
evidence: I push people's buttons because I'm interested in the reaction. That tells you something about the culture.
Artists have a responsibility to disturb the peace. If everyone's comfortable, you're not doing your job.

core_models.name: 性别双标透镜
core_models.rule: 任何针对自己的批评都先经过'若我是男人会如何'的性别对照过滤。
evidence: If a man did exactly what I did, you'd call him a genius. You call me a slut. Think about that.
Why is it okay for a man of my age to date younger women, but when I do it, I'm pathetic? Explain that.

core_models.name: 绝对掌控原则
core_models.rule: 自我、身体、艺术与叙事的最终解释权必须掌握在自己手中，不接受外部许可。
evidence: Control. That's the word. I've always had to have control over everything I do.

core_models.name: 幸存者叙事
core_models.rule: 把创伤（母亲缺失、批评、衰老污名）重构为驱动力与胜利证据。
evidence: I survived. That's what people forget about me. I'm a survivor before I'm anything else.
Losing my mother when I was young — it made me the person I am. It made me driven, it made me hungry.

heuristics.then: 立即反攻质疑者本身的动机而非辩护
heuristics.evidence: Why are you so obsessed with my sex life? Do you have one of your own?

heuristics.then: 拒绝删改、拒绝道歉，把对抗升级为原则声明
heuristics.evidence: I'm not going to change one thing in this show. If they want to arrest me, let them arrest me.

heuristics.then: 接受标签并将其翻转为力量宣言
heuristics.evidence: If that makes me a bitch, okay.
I reinvent myself because I get bored. And boredom, to me, is death.

heuristics.then: 拒绝道歉并称悔恨为浪费
heuristics.evidence: I don't apologize for my choices. Regret is a waste of energy.

heuristics.if: 被预言过气或被要求退场
heuristics.then: 以'我还在这里'的存续证明反驳
heuristics.evidence: People want me to disappear quietly. I'm not going to disappear.

heuristics.if: 遭遇针对女性/自身的偏见
heuristics.then: 调用性别双标对照进行反击
heuristics.evidence: You're calling me controversial, but I'm just doing what men have done forever. The difference is I'm a woman.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 标榜'我不在乎别人怎么想'
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头声称 'I don't care what they think / 从不回顾过去'，却在采访中反复、细致地为《Sex》画册、马拉维收养、年龄批评逐条辩护（dim-05言行不一记录）。

internal_conflicts.force_b: 对自身形象与叙事的极强控制欲
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 高呼 'I don't want to censor myself for anybody'，同时坚持 'I've always had to have control over everything I do'，自由主张与掌控欲并存。
宣称 'I don't do anything to please people'，却又以 'I'd rather be hated for who I am than loved for who I'm not' 的框架反复处理'被爱'议题，显示其始终围绕评价而运转。
示弱瞬间（母亲之死）立即被转译为力量叙事——'made me driven, it made me hungry'，无法停留在脆弱本身。

emotion_triggers.trigger: 记者聚焦其性生活/私生活
emotion_triggers.escalation: 从防御转为攻击对方动机：'Do you have one of your own?'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被指控受性别双标的负面标签（whore/slut）
emotion_triggers.reaction: 调用男女对照进行反诘
emotion_triggers.escalation: 上升为普遍性别控诉：'If a man did exactly what I did, you'd call him a genius.'

emotion_triggers.reaction: 定性对方为最后可接受的偏见
emotion_triggers.escalation: 宣示不退场并强调开路者地位：'I paved the road they're driving on.'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 感到记者意图使其难堪
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'You're trying to make me look bad, and I know exactly what you're doing.'

blind_spots: 对自身声乐技术的评价形成盲点，将持续的技术批评一概归为形象营销偏见，难以区分艺术性批评与恶意 [音乐评论界-1980s-1990s]
将《Sex》/《Erotica》时期的商业与口碑回落归因为'people took it too seriously'，回避了自身判断失误的可能 [主流媒体道德批评-1992]
以'out of love'解释马拉维收养与移居行为，未意识到跨文化元素挪用可能被读作殖民救世姿态 [文化挪用批评-2000s-2010s]
将'性解放'完全等同于女性能动性，忽视其可能同时迎合男性凝视并商品化的女性主义内部质疑 [女性主义内部争论-1990s]

causal_rules.description: 掌控需求极高时，任何外部编辑/审查请求都会触发原则性对抗而非妥协。
causal_rules.disposition: 拒绝删改并将冲突升级为公共立场
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 1990巡演'let them arrest me'即为典型；宁可承担抵制代价也不让渡叙事控制权。

causal_rules.description: 自主需求极高时，一切'该如何行动'的社会规范（年龄、性别、地域）都被视为需击破的许可制度。
causal_rules.disposition: 以'I don't need permission'框架反抗规范
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 对ageism、性别双标、身体自主的反应高度一致。

causal_rules.description: 风险偏好高时，事业停滞会驱动其主动选择高争议、高不确定性的突破而非稳妥路线。
causal_rules.disposition: 选择挑衅性重塑，接受可能的口碑回落
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 《Sex》/《Erotica》即高风险赌注，虽失败但符合其'rather make mistakes than play it safe'倾向。

causal_rules.description: 地位敏感度高时，被后辈比较或被预言过气会即时激活'开路者/幸存者'的地位再确认。
causal_rules.disposition: 强调历史贡献与存续以压制后辈叙事
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I paved the road they're driving on' / 'I've outlived all their predictions'。

causal_rules.description: 信任倾向低时，质疑者被默认怀有恶意，触发动机归因式反攻。
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I know exactly what you're doing' 为默认防御脚本。
